description: Source code implementing hash-based analysis for diffing binary and text data, including functions for hashing chunks, rehashing, and counting changes between file specifications.

classes.name: spanhash
classes.description: Structure representing a hash value and its count.

classes.name: spanhash_top
classes.description: Structure managing a dynamic array of spanhash entries with rehashing capabilities.

methods.name: spanhash_rehash
methods.description: Rehashes the spanhash table into a larger table to reduce collisions.

methods.name: add_spanhash
methods.description: Adds a hash value and count to the spanhash table, rehashing if necessary.

methods.name: spanhash_cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting spanhash entries by hash value and count.

methods.name: hash_chars
methods.description: Generates hash buckets for a file's data, distinguishing text and binary files.
